description: Admin UI surface from Appendix A. Manage mcp_exemptions records. Must expose: create exemption (mcp_server_id, valid_until, reason, granted_by), revoke exemption (set status='revoked'), list active exemptions. Uses mcp_exemptions table via write_service API. Binds on port 8790. Must include XSS sanitization on all user inputs. No direct DB access.
